description: List the weather locations this server covers — the five US agricultural regions that get_weather, get_forecast and get_weather_history accept. Returns an object with `count` (number of locations) and `locations`, an array where each entry has `key` (the location key to pass as the `location` argument to the other tools, e.g. "IL-central"), `label` (human-readable region name), `lat` and `lon` (the region's coordinates in decimal degrees). Use this first when you do not know which location keys exist; the set is fixed, so no NOAA call is made and the answer never changes between calls. No API key.

limit.description: Max locations to return, in list order (default: all 5)

name: list_locations
